_comment: Seed roster for Powerman Zofingen 2026, Team USA long distance.
Canonical source of truth: this file is committed, so losing a machine loses nothing
but runtime edits. Age-group slugs are derived from year of birth using World
Triathlon age-on-31-December rules, because the age-group rank column does not exist
Olivia Dietzel races elite, which has no age groups and no published bib pre-race;
her agegroup_list_slug is intentionally empty and the UI hides the scope toggle.
_excluded_comment: Mats the second run crosses repeatedly. A checkpoint query returns each athlete last crossing, so standings there compare one athlete lap 2 against another lap 4. Detected from a 2025 participant split table; re-verify with DatasportProvider.detect_multi_crossing_labels once 2026 has a finisher.
